title: Regional staged activation framework and release-notes orchestration for lighthouse pilots
creator: Marisol Vega
description:
Purpose: Define and run a staged activation (wave) plan for lighthouse pilot accounts across regions, while owning synchronized release notes and GTM artifacts. Goal: get 6 lighthouse accounts into production-like usage across NA/EU/APAC with documented feedback, documented release notes, and aligned cross-functional support before broad beta.

Scope: regional waves (internal -> NA -> EU -> APAC), release-notes ops (draft -> legal & security review -> translations -> website & email), CS/GTM enablement materials, instrumentation and dashboards for success signals, and a feedback triage loop tied to product tickets. Excludes long-term pricing changes and large dedicated capacity contracts (those will be separate sales motions).

Why this ticket: Past pilots had ad-hoc onboarding and release notes that led to mismatched expectations, delayed fixes, and an overload on support during wave expansion. This initiative standardizes handoffs and gating so waves can scale predictably.
acceptance_criteria: Three regional waves executed (NA, EU, APAC) with at least 2 lighthouse accounts each moved to production-like traffic
Release notes for the Pilot feature set are drafted, security-reviewed, localized (EN/FR/DE/JA) and published to the public docs site before each regional wave start
CS knowledge base and zero-to-hello-world KB article published and linked in each customer welcome pack
Instrumentation: event pipeline emits onboarding and quality signals, and a dashboard with activation/latency/error KPIs is visible to PM/Eng/CS
Feedback loop: all pilot feedback is captured into a triage board (PM-owned) and prioritized with SLA (48h triage, 10 business days for engineering assessment)
Success criteria met for first wave: >=70% activation (first hour successful inference) and <=1.5% critical error rate within 7 days

gating_criteria: Telemetry green: 95th p50 latency within target and critical error rate <=1.5% for 48h
Support readiness: CS and SE trained, KB published, on-call escalation path documented
Release notes and legal signoff complete and published
At least one PR with documentation changes merged to docs site and the What's New email ready
metrics: Activation (first successful inference) within 1 hour - target >=70%
Latency P50/P95 targets: P50 < 120ms, P95 < 800ms for pilot traffic
Number of meaningful product requests captured (feature asks or blockers) >= 10 per wave
stakeholders: Sofia Ramos (Design) - onboarding flows and customer-facing docs
Rohit Malhotra (GTM) - release notes & customer comms
channels: email: pilot-gov@redwood.ai - official customer comms alias
risks: Late security/legal signoff delaying a regional wave
Telemetry gaps (missing events) causing blindspots during escalation
Underestimation of region-specific integration work for lighthouse customers (VPC/KMS differences)
Support overload if KB or playbook missing details
mitigations: Pre-book legal/security review blocks and allocate expedited review slot for pilot
Telemetry smoke tests included in Wave 0 and runbook to validate event emission
Collect integration checklists from solutions engineers beforehand and include as gating item
Create a compact 'first-responder' runbook and pair CS with Eng on-call for first 72h
Parallelize translations and freeze copy 10 days before wave start
deliverables: Published release notes and KB articles (EN/FR/DE/JA)
Onboarding checklist and welcome pack template
Telemetry dashboard and runbook with escalation paths
Feedback triage board and SLA documentation
